name: ANS 1964
description: Independent emulation of the 1964 five-disc ANS photoelectronic synthesizer: 720 optical sine partials at 1/72-octave spacing, a drawn-sonogram score scanner with on-device XYPad drawing, 20 half-octave tube channels, and a 16-harmonic coder with formant templates. Built for MPC OS 3.10.1+ and desktop VST2 hosts.
author: bokontep
